### Least Count Definition
Least count is the smallest measurement that can be accurately read with a given measuring instrument.

### Calculation
Given that $1\text{ cm}$ is divided into $10$ equal divisions:
$$\text{Least Count} = \frac{\text{Value of 1 main division}}{\text{Total number of divisions}} = \frac{1\text{ cm}}{10} = 0.1\text{ cm} = 1\text{ mm}$$
proTip: Always check the unit requested in the final answer (cm or mm).
